create_Humans300M_dataset: create a Humans300M dataset instance with airstore_id and split for training person detection models
iterate_Humans300M_samples: iterate over Humans300M dataset samples using the iterator with automatic error retry and caching
map_item_decode_image: map a raw airstore row to a decoded BGR image tensor with description metadata via _map_item
open_airstore_iterator: open a distributed airstore iterator with worker-aware sharding, random seed, and shuffle enabled
get_data_info_by_index: get data info dict with img_path, gt_label, and sample_idx for a given dataset index
